_howto: This is what you author. Everything else - ticket text, agent briefs, tracker payloads - is rendered from it by emit.py. Fill it in phase order, delete this key, then run validate.py. See assets/examples/example-bundle.json for a complete one.

story.source_text: PHASE 1: the original ask, verbatim. Scope creep is detected against this.

intake._howto: PHASE 1: run `intake.py assess --bundle bundle.json --write`, then read source_text and set heuristic:false on every dimension you confirm. Statuses: present (quote it) | missing (blocking question) | assumed (assumption + non-blocking question) | answered (answer + answered_by).

story.summary_human: PHASE 6: why and what, within the word budget.
story.technical_notes_human: PHASE 6: what changes, where, what was decided. Every path cited.
non_goals: PHASE 3: what this story is not, with follow-up ticket ids.

sources: PHASE 2: which of index / manifest / scan produced this

subtasks.title: [repo] Verb object
subtasks.human: PHASE 6: within the word budget, assumes shared context.

forbidden: Do not edit files another subtask owns.
agent_brief.context_budget_hint: read_first only; do not index the repo

review._howto: PHASE 8: once validate.py is green, run `review.py brief --bundle bundle.json --out reviews/` and hand each sealed packet to a separate critic in fresh context. Record what they found here, resolve every finding, re-validate, then `review.py digest --bundle bundle.json --stamp`.
review.bundle_digest: PHASE 8: written by `review.py digest --stamp`. Never typed by hand.

critics.attempted: only when this critic raised nothing: what it tried to break, and why it held

findings.claim: what is wrong, in one sentence
findings.failure: who does what, and what they wrongly get, if this ships as is
findings.resolution: what changed. accepted -> the risk and who accepted it; disputed -> the rebuttal and its evidence
